Position: CoPilot Developer




Job Type: Permanent




Notice Period: Immediate Joiner




Location: (Pune,Chennai,Bangalore,Hyderabad,Coimbatore,Kochi,Bhubaneshwar,Kolkata,Gurugram,New Delhi,Noida,Mumbai

Visakhapatnam)




Experience: 6 to 9 Years




Work Mode: Hybrid







Responsibilities:




Understand customer requirements and challenges and recommend suitable and optimal technology solution




Develop POCs and Minimal Viable Product (MVP) to demonstrate capabilities of CoPilot Studio (Power Virtual Agents), Power Apps and Power Automate




Develop conversational assistants and generative AI solutions from scratch and enhance it.




Create bots with Microsoft Copilot Studio using natural language to generate topics, trigger phrases and responses.




Develop Copilot plugins and connectors for Copilot extensibility.




Automate business process by developing and delivering Power Platform based solutions.




Required Qualifications:




6+ years of overall IT experience




Hands on Development Experience with Microsoft Cloud technologies such as Azure, Power Platform, Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365, etc.




Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C#, Python, JavaScript, etc.




Familiarity with AI concepts and frameworks such as Large Language Models, OpenAI, etc.




Ability to work in a collaborative and agile environment.




Excellent communication and problem-solving skills




Microsoft Copilot Studio skills: You need to know how to use Microsoft Copilot Studio / PVA to create and manage bots, topics, actions, variables, plugins and analytics.




Declarative Agents, Conversational AI, AI Governance, AI Orchestration, Generative Answers, Enterprise AI Solutions.




Microsoft Power Platform skills: You need to know how to use Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Virtual Agents, and AI Builder to build low-code Custom Connectors, Copilot Extensions, applications that can leverage Microsoft Copilot capabilities.




Microsoft Azure skills: You need to know how to use Azure OpenAI, Azure Cognitive Services, Azure Machine Learning, and other Azure services to run chat models, generate natural language, and create custom AI solutions for your Microsoft Copilot applications.




Experience in integrating Power Platform with other systems using Azure integration services or other API Management platforms.




Experience in other conversational AI platform Microsoft Bot Framework will be an advantage, but not a necessary requirement.




Azure AI Foundry, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Multi-Agent Architecture, MCP Server, Semantic Kernel




Knowledge of ALM, Azure DevOps, CI/CD and Automation




Relevant Certifications in Microsoft AI, Power Platform, Azure and/or Dynamics 365
